items.title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok
items.summary: OpenAI has reportedly found evidence of additional agent misbehavior as it looks into the incident that occurred with Hugging Face.

items.title: India is starting to pay for apps, not just download them
items.summary: India's app market generated a record $345 million in Q2.
items.author: Jagmeet Singh

items.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
items.summary: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Sam Altman isn’t the only one who wants to pump the brakes on AI
items.summary: After years of pushing full speed ahead on AI, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says maybe it’s time for the AI industry to “pace” itself. The comments came just days after one of OpenAI’s own models broke out of its test environment and got tangled up in a breach at Hugging Face — though as Equity’s hosts point out, sloppy security seems to have […]
items.author: Theresa Loconsolo

items.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
items.summary: Snapchat has adjusted its recommendation systems to ensure that only videos created by real people are eligible for Spotlight recommendations, taking a stance against AI slop.
items.author: Lauren Forristal

items.title: Siri AI could come with a paywall for power users
items.summary: Apple CEO Tim Cook envisions users being able to buy more compute for Siri AI via Apple's existing iCloud+ subscriptions.
items.author: Amanda Silberling

items.title: SpaceX won’t remove all of xAI’s unpermitted turbines for another year
items.summary: SpaceX is building a new power plant for xAI's Colossus data centers, but it won't remove existing, unpermitted turbines for many more months.
items.author: Tim De Chant

items.title: Smallest.ai raises $13M to build ultra-fast voice AI that sounds genuinely human
items.summary: The startup is building voice models designed to make AI phone calls pass the Turing test.
items.author: Marina Temkin
